text:
incident-bot: 🔔 [PagerDuty] page fired: PD-98321 — embeddings-service high 5xx rate (eu-west-1). Auto-bridge: created pd-bridge-98321. severity: P1.

pagerbot: @SRE-Oncall (Emma) claimed the page (auto-claim).

SRE-Oncall (Emma): acked. I'm on it, taking the bridge. Starting quick triage — maya, omar, can you hold customer pings?

Maya: adding context — saw spike at 14:02 UTC, ~8k 5xx/min, mostly 502s from the embeddings inference tier. No deploys reported in the last 30m.

Omar: noted. I'm checking autoscaler logs and kv-cache eviction rates. Might be a cache storm. Will paste logs if I find anything.

eng-ops-bot: Runbook matched: "embeddings-502-spike" (steps: validate-origins -> check-kv-cache -> isolate-host). URL: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-502-spike

SRE-Oncall (Emma): running first checks: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embeddings -o wide`

SRE-Oncall (Emma): pod list shows 3/5 pods NotReady on node gpu-eu-12, repeated CrashLoopBackOff across a few containers.

pagerbot: Automatic duplicate suppression: another page PD-98322 suppressed (duplicate of PD-98321).

Maya: @pagerbot FYI we had a maintenance suppression window scheduled for 13:45-14:15 but it ended. This is post-window.

Support-Liaison (Jon): customer-impact check — which customers hit >5% error rate? I can start triage comms.

SRE-Oncall (Emma): quick query: `SELECT customer_id, error_pct FROM telemetry.errors WHERE service='embeddings' AND ts > now()-INTERVAL '5 minutes' ORDER BY error_pct DESC LIMIT 10;` Results: cust_alpha 23%, cust_zeta 12%, internal-test 9%.

Support-Liaison (Jon): started notifying the on-call AE for cust_alpha, flagged SLO risk. Will send an initial note: "We're investigating increased 5xx for embeddings; may impact embeddings generation. We'll update in 15m."

Omar: digging into GPU node: `dmesg | tail -n 50` shows repeated OOM-killer events targeting the inference process and then a restart loop. Looks like memory pressure around 14:01.

SRE-Oncall (Emma): thanks. Temporarily scaling down large-batch jobs to reduce memory footprint: `kubectl scale deployment batch-encoder --replicas=0 --namespace=batch-jobs` — pause heavy encoders.

Maya: I can flip a routing rule to move critical customers (cust_alpha) to a healthy replica set in us-east as an emergency fallback. Want to coordinate?

SRE-Oncall (Emma): yes, prepare the route change but hold until I confirm KV cache state. If we flush caches we lose warm prefixes — balance risk.

Omar: KV cache hitrate dropped 60% before the crash, and there are stalled writes to redis-eu-primary. I'm restarting redis on node redis-eu-3: `systemctl restart redis`.

eng-ops-bot: automated action logged: redis-eu-3 restarted by Omar @ 14:09 UTC.

SRE-Oncall (Emma): after restart, pods are gradually recovering. Observing 5xx drop from 8000/min -> 1200/min in the last 2 mins. CPU/mem settling.

Support-Liaison (Jon): updating cust_alpha with: "We saw transient errors due to node memory pressure; mitigation in progress, partial recovery observed. Next update in 10 minutes."

Maya: prepping canary route: ready to switch cust_alpha to us-east fallback. Standby for the green light.

SRE-Oncall (Emma): hold. waiting for steady <500 5xx/min and rs-memory stable. If we failover now we may cold-start large prefixes.

pagerbot: PD incident PD-98321 auto-escalation in 10m unless manually updated.

SRE-Oncall (Emma): updated PD with note: "working mitigation — restarted redis-eu-3, scaling down batch jobs, monitoring. No full failover yet."

Omar: metrics now: 5xx = 220/min — continuing downward trend. KV latency back to normal.

eng-ops-bot: metric alert cleared: embeddings-5xx-high (eu-west-1).

Support-Liaison (Jon): customer comms: sent follow-up to cust_alpha: "Errors reduced, service degrading to normal range, continuing to monitor. Will report when fully resolved."

SRE-Oncall (Emma): marking incident: mitigation successful. Moving to post-incident analysis. Please add any notes in the bridge.

Maya: note — consider adding a temporary suppression rule for maintenance windows that overlap autoscaling warmup; it tripped some duplicate logic.

Omar: note — looks like a sequence: KV write stall -> pod memory balloon -> OOM -> restart loop. Suggest adding a redis replica failover automation.

Support-Liaison (Jon): customers notified, no SLA credits requested atm.

pagerbot: PD-98321 status updated: acknowledged -> mitigated -> resolved. Bridge pd-bridge-98321 closed.

incident-bot: closing thread. postmortem assigned to #postmortems and to Emma, Omar, Maya.

SRE-Oncall (Emma): thx team. will follow up with a short RCA draft in ~2 hours. :thumbsup:
